verdict.rationale: dlt has no native in-product AI insights feature. Its AI Harness supplies skills and MCP servers to external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Through these, an agent can run read-only SQL against the pipeline's dataset and turn an analysis plan into marimo chart notebooks, so AI-driven analysis of your data is possible but depends on a third-party agent. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, documentation of insight or recommendation generation (beyond chart assembly from a plan), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
